projects.title: Neural Process Twin
projects.tagline: Physics-Aware Machine Learning Surrogate Simulator for Physical Field Prediction
verified_outcomes: Constructed deep learning surrogate models mapping thermal conductivity fields and volumetric heat sources to 2D steady-state temperature distributions.
Demonstrated orders-of-magnitude faster inference compared to conventional finite difference and finite element solvers.
Preserved physical consistency by embedding physical PDE constraints and quantifying predictive uncertainty.

projects.title: LLM Inference Intelligence Engine
projects.tagline: Measurement-Driven LLM Inference Benchmarking, Diagnostics & Optimization
verified_outcomes: Built modular framework for introspecting hardware ceilings (memory bandwidth, compute FLOPs) across CPU and GPU topologies.
Instrumented prefill (TTFT) and decode (TPOT/ITL) phases under variable batching and concurrency workloads.
Implemented Roofline model diagnostics to isolate memory-bandwidth saturation versus compute bounds in transformer serving.

projects.title: Finite-Difference Error Estimation in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
projects.tagline: Independent Audit, Reproduction & Boundary Constraint Extension for PINN Residual Defect Solvers
verified_outcomes: Audited and independently reproduced Krasowski et al. (arXiv:2603.15526) residual-based error estimation methodology on 1D Heat Equation benchmarks.
Extended the benchmark evaluation to soft boundary constraints, analyzing pointwise defect propagation without closed-form analytical solutions.
Conducted rigorous validation across discretization intervals and neural network architectural variations.

projects.title: Peng-Robinson Real-Gas Cubic Equation of State Solver
projects.tagline: Modern C++17 Scientifically Validated High-Performance Thermodynamic Engine
verified_outcomes: Engineered robust C++17 pure-component PVT state solver implementing the canonical Peng-Robinson (PR-1976) cubic equation of state.
Solved dimensionless cubic polynomials in compressibility factor Z, discarding unphysical roots (Z <= B).
Evaluated analytical derivative (dP/dv)_T for thermodynamic mechanical stability classification and computed departure enthalpy, entropy, and fugacity coefficients.

projects.title: Humanoid Robotics & Embedded Control Platform
projects.tagline: Multi-Degree-of-Freedom Servo Kinematics and Microcontroller Perception System
verified_outcomes: Designed and assembled multi-DOF servo-actuated robotic mechanisms with closed-loop positional feedback.
Programmed embedded microcontrollers for low-latency motor control, trajectory generation, and sensor telemetry.
Implemented sensor integration routines for environmental perception and basic gait/motion coordination.

projects.title: SuRGE Microdrone Autonomy & 3D Environment Mapping
projects.tagline: Selected Undergraduate Research Excellence in Mathematical Methods, Microelectronics & Autonomous Systems
verified_outcomes: Selected for competitive SuRGE programme under Prof. Amartansh Dubey (Electrical Engineering, IIT Delhi).
Explored microdrone autonomy problem centred on 3D environment mapping and trajectory path following.
Synthesized core perception, state estimation, planning, and control interactions under limited sensing and uncertainty.

projects.title: Sovereign On-Premise Agentic AI Workbench
projects.tagline: On-Premise Agentic AI Workbench for Confidential Industrial Work (MRPL, SIH 2026)
verified_outcomes: Completed 6-person team project designing on-premise agentic AI workbench for confidential industrial workflows using open-weight multimodal LLMs.
Led system architecture across model engineering, multimodal processing, retrieval, tool sandboxing, security, and UI workstreams.
Contributed to orchestration and authentication/security design with attention to component interfaces, controlled tool access, and confidential deployment boundaries.

projects.title: OPVI Opportunity Intelligence Platform
projects.tagline: Deployed Full-Stack MVP for Opportunity Discovery and Personalized Workflow Tracking
verified_outcomes: Designed and independently built full-stack deployed MVP for discovering and acting on research opportunities, internships, and competitions.
Engineered opportunity discovery, personalized filtering, and deadline-aware follow-up workflows.
Linked backend data pipelines to usable web interface, making scattered research opportunities actionable.
